marks: first U fill if within 40 sessions
charts.selection: deterministic representative sample from simple-rule matches, preserving successes and failures where available
charts.window: 90 completed sessions before gap through max(90 sessions after gap, 40 after causal first return)

descriptive_conditions.interpretation: in-sample descriptive regularity only; no out-of-sample or predictive claim
descriptive_conditions.selection: greedy at most 3 conditions; each addition must improve pooled U_FILL_20 by >=2 percentage points, have positive median calendar-year uplift, retain >=40 events and >=5 represented years
descriptive_conditions.selector_order: more calendar years with positive uplift; then median calendar-year uplift; then pooled uplift; then support; then deterministic feature name
descriptive_conditions.thresholds: full-discovery q30/q50/q70 in the predeclared economic direction; count features additionally permit natural zero

corridor_density.definition: raw VAP per 0.1W bin inside z=[-0.5,1.5), divided by raw VAP per 0.1W bin in z=[-2,3)

stage_a_outcome_blind_mother_population.history: exactly 120 completed same-lineage hard-valid PIT sessions with 241 one-minute bars before gap formation

inside_gap_density.definition: raw VAP per 0.1W bin inside z=[0,1), divided by raw VAP per 0.1W bin in z=[-2,3)

stage_b_structural_outcome.primary: frozen structural U full-fill within 20 completed trading sessions after V6 causal first return

mission: From a broad pre-2021 low-inventory downward true-gap population, describe which frozen causal first returns later complete U and reduce the observed regularity to a few simple in-sample conditions for chart review.
